title.zh: 创建一个新的 Polarlakebase 全球数据网络（GDN）

descriptions.zh:
> 该 API 创建一个 Polarlakebase 的全球数据网络（GlobalDataNetwork
），请注意与 PolarDB 集群的创建全球数据库网络（CreateGlobalDatabaseNetwork）区分
descriptions.en: > This API creates a PolarFileSystem (PolarFS) Global Data Network (GDN). Do not confuse it with the CreateGlobalDatabaseNetwork API, which operates on a PolarDB cluster. Ensure you are using the correct API to avoid unintended actions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb create-global-data-network --description mygdn --source-id pcs-xxx --destination-id pfs-xxx --source-file-system-path / --destination-file-system-path / --source-type pcs --destination-type pfs --source-region cn-wulanchabu --destination-region cn-beijing --freeze-source-during-sync true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb CreateGlobalDataNetwork --region cn-hangzhou --Description mygdn --SourceId 'pcs-xxx' --SourceType pcs --DestinationFileSystemPath '/' --DestinationRegion 'cn-beijing' --DestinationType pfs --SourceRegion 'cn-wulanchabu' --DestinationId 'pfs-xxx' --SourceFileSystemPath '/' --FreezeSourceDuringSync true
